content: The interaction between nadolol and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter may alter the drug's levels or effects. Caution is advised, and monitoring is recommended. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of elagolix by influencing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of naldemedine via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter but also decreases naldemedine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate inducer of CYP3A4. When co-administered with CYP3A substrates, monitoring is essential, and dose adjustments may be necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels of naloxegol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Nefazodone increases the levels or effects of elagolix by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. Co-administration of elagolix 200 mg twice daily with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. Elagolix decreases nefazodone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir via CYP2C19 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. Nelfinavir also increases elagolix levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix decreases nelfinavir levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Elagolix decreases the levels of netupitant/palonosetron, nevirapine, nicardipine, nifedipine, nilotinib, nimodipine, nintedanib, nisoldipine, norethindrone, norethindrone acetate, norgestrel, olaparib, ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir & dasabuvir, ondansetron, osimertinib, ospemifene, oxycodone, paclitaxel, paclitaxel protein-bound, palbociclib, panobinostat, paricalcitol, pazopanib, pentamidine, perampanel, pexidartinib, phenobarbital, phenytoin, pimavanserin, pimozide, pitolisant, polatuzumab vedotin, pomalidomide, ponatinib, posaconazole, pravastatin, prednisolone, primaquine, progesterone intravaginal gel, progesterone micronized, quazepam, quetiapine, quinidine, quinine, rabeprazole, ranolazine, regorafenib, repaglinide, ribociclib, rifabutin, rifampin, rifapentine, rifaximin, riociguat, ripretinib, risperidone, ritonavir, rivaroxaban, roflumilast, rolapitant, romidepsin, ropivacaine, rosuvastatin, ruxolitinib, ruxolitinib topical, salmeterol, saxagliptin, sildenafil, silodosin, and siltuximab by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of omeprazole, pantoprazole, pentamidine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, progesterone micronized, quinidine, quinine, rabeprazole, ranolazine, rifampin, risperidone, ritonavir, saxagliptin, silodosin, and siltuximab by affecting CYP2C19 metabolism or the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Rucaparib increases the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate and elagolix by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. Rufinamide decreases the effects of norethindrone acetate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels of ruxolitinib, salmeterol, and other CYP3A4 substrates. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are required. Siltuximab may restore CYP450 activity in the liver by inhibiting IL-6, which is downregulated during infection and inflammation. Caution and monitoring are advised.
